Company Description
TrueTandem's mission is to be a trusted information technology solutions provider, committed to the success of our customers, communities and employees. To enable this mission, we listen to our customers’ needs, empower our dedicated and talented employees, envision success together, and deliver innovative cost-effective solutions. For our customers, we aim to deliver more power to meet their business outcomes through technology implementation, integration, optimization and customization. We enable some of the most well-known companies, nonprofits and federal agencies in the United States to intelligently plan and develop their applications, modernize their infrastructure and manage their data.


As a Data Engineer within the solutions delivery team, you will contribute to the modernization of mission-critical government systems. In collaboration with multidisciplinary stakeholders, you will design secure integrations among the portal, Microsoft Power Platform, Azure services, existing systems, SQL Server, and approved file-transfer services. This role supports health-screening data collection, workflow automation, notifications, results delivery, reporting, and analytics while preserving the authoritative system of record. All solutions must comply with approved GCC cloud environments, FISMA Moderate security requirements, federal privacy controls, Agile delivery practices, and Enterprise Performance Life Cycle requirements.
 
Our delivery teams value innovation, collaboration, feedback, and continuous improvement. We use Agile and automate-first DevSecOps practices, modern technology stacks, and iterative delivery. Successful team members work independently, collaborate effectively, and bring strong coding and problem-solving skills to complex customer challenges.
 
Role and Responsibilities:
Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain secure ETL/ELT processes for structured and unstructured public health data.
Develop scalable batch, scheduled, event-driven, and near-real-time pipelines for portal intake, validation, workflows, reporting, analytics, and bidirectional MHS exchange.
Integrate Power Pages, Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Azure services, APIs, SQL Server, systems, and approved file-transfer platforms.
Develop secure MHS SQL Server integrations using approved APIs, stored procedures, connectors, gateways, hybrid connections, or VPN interfaces; prohibit direct public database access.  
Required Skills
Five or more years of experience in data engineering, systems integration, data warehousing, analytics engineering, or database development.
Hands-on experience constructing and maintaining production ETL and ELT pipelines using SQL and Python.
Strong SQL Server development skills, including queries, views, stored procedures, data modeling, performance optimization, and controlled database interfaces.

Additional Information
TrueTandem is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and affords equal opportunity to all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to protected veteran status, qualified individuals with disabilities and all individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or any other status protected under local, state or federal laws.  

Equal Opportunity Employer - Minorities/Females/Disabled/Veterans
